rationale: ADR 0043 re-derives the explicit canonical collection from 14 current members and the measured four-member peak active day. Twenty-one is the smallest bound keeping 14 below the 80% warning and 18 below the 90% rollover; 20 is insufficient because 18/20 is exactly rollover. Per-file limits and explicit stable paths remain unchanged, and both aggregates remain files times per-file limits.
